knowledgeAdded: Evidence must be collected before judgment.
Multiple independent evidence sources increase confidence when they corroborate one another.
Weak evidence must not outrank strong evidence.
Conflicting evidence should lower confidence and can require review.
Insufficient evidence is not proof of the opposite claim.
remainingGaps: No dedicated official GCAM evidence hierarchy article or slide was found in the repository source set.
Evidence handling remains an operational reviewer interpretation rather than a directly sourced GCAM rule.
